unmeasured.lever: prompt-context Tier 1 (entity summary vs HA's Static Context roster dump)
unmeasured.measures_it: a summary-on against summary-off pass over the same corpus
unmeasured.why: both name-injection arms ran with the summary applied, so the A/B never isolated the summary itself

unmeasured.lever: undo coverage of locally handled mutations
unmeasured.measures_it: HassUndo as a local intent, plus a core intent chokepoint emitting the same outcome contract
unmeasured.why: locally routed turns never reach the proxy, so their mutations do not enter the journal; at a 14/25 off-cloud rate that is most of them

unmeasured.measures_it: the controlled voice pipeline layer, with a labelled real-engine profile
unmeasured.why: the wave clocks provider rounds only; no controlled pipeline driver exists yet

unmeasured.lever: argument correctness of a local action with no state or effect trace
unmeasured.measures_it: an ExpectedEffect declared at the external boundary of such a capability
unmeasured.why: no Wave 0 case has that shape, so the residual is a shape rather than a gap

notes: Nothing in the integration reads the setting, so the deliverable is a recorded verdict and a README step, not a code change.
None of the three routing disagreements is the local matcher taking a turn it should not have, so the false-positive pre-emption the design warned about did not appear.
The off-cloud count is a floor: `weather` matched locally and fell through only because the fixture home has no weather integration.
local.prefer_local_intents.question: How much of the corpus does the local matcher take off the cloud path?
local.prefer_local_intents.ships: not ours to ship: a Home Assistant pipeline setting, recommended in the README

notes: The task-success gate passes and exposure falls by nearly half, so the flag is not held by task success.
Recall does not move with budget: the miss list is identical at 8, 12, 16, 24, and 50, so it is a retrieval floor and a wider budget buys nothing.
The independent blocker is localization: retrieval documents are English, and an English catalog scoring German utterances strands the corpus.
tokens.capability_selection.question: Can the tool roster be cut per request without losing task success?
tokens.capability_selection.reopens: the localized-document builder moving into the component, and a retrieval signal that reaches name-only scripts; both scoped into Wave 2

notes: Costs more, not less: per-turn names sit inside the single cached system block and re-prefill it every turn.
No Wave 1 tool consumes an entity_id, so the find_entities round-trip the tier exists to skip is never taken.
The selector keys on name overlap and domain keywords, so it goes silent on the oblique references the tier was justified by.
Scored before the 2026-08-06 re-scoring; both arms used the same scorer, so the comparison holds and only the absolute buckets are dated.
tokens.name_injection.question: Does request-conditioned name injection (prompt-context Tier 2) reduce spend?
tokens.name_injection.reopens: the first tool that consumes an entity_id, in Wave 3, measured against the cache-isolated second system block rather than the single cached block

notes: Every genuine ambiguity cost exactly one extra turn, and no case misfired by acting on a guess.
This is the one Wave 1 lever that ships on by default.
turns.find_entities.question: Does deterministic fuzzy resolution complete a task in fewer turns?
turns.find_entities.ships: on (both consumers wired into the testbed roster)
